dimensions.assessment: Directly affects federal agency employees, members of the Armed Forces, reserve components, and qualifying federal contractors nationwide during funding lapses.
dimensions.evidence: each employee of an agency... a member of the Armed Forces on active duty... contractor of the agency

dimensions.assessment: Ensures continuous receipt of standard employee compensation and pay allowances during government shutdowns, preventing missed paychecks.
dimensions.evidence: there are appropriated... such sums as are necessary to provide standard employee compensation

dimensions.assessment: Appropriates open-ended sums necessary from the Treasury for employee and contractor pay during any lapse in regular appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: there are appropriated to the head of the agency, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as are necessary

dimensions.assessment: Applies government-wide across executive, legislative, and judicial branches, as well as the District of Columbia public employers.
dimensions.evidence: each authority of the executive, legislative, or judicial branch of the Government of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Applies to fiscal year 2026 and any fiscal year thereafter during any future or ongoing lapse in regular appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: For fiscal year 2026, and any fiscal year thereafter, for any lapse in regular appropriations

missing_information: Total dollar amount needed for continuous appropriations during a shutdown
Exact number of contractors qualifying as covered contract employees
importance_detail.rationale: Appropriates continuous funds during any lapse in regular appropriations to pay standard compensation for federal employees, covered contractors, and members of the Armed Forces.
